The expansive four-bedroom main home is complemented by a private one-bedroom ADU with its own entrance and outdoor space, creating exceptional flexibility for guests, extended family, a home office, or rental income. The main residence features bright, open living spaces, refined custom finishes, a designer kitchen, and a finished basement with 10-foot ceilings, a wet bar, game room, full bathroom, and impressive 150-inch home theater.
